title: Level test
description: The check at the end of a level. Twenty gapped sentences, each answered from a short list of options, marked all at once at the end rather than one at a time — this is a test, not practice, and telling the learner after every question turns it back into a drill.

passMark.description: Fraction correct needed to pass. 0.8 across A1-C1.

sentence.description: The sentence with the gap written as _____. Everything either side is context the learner reads.

options.description: Real forms used wrongly, never invented words — a nonsense option is not a mistake anyone would make, and rules itself out without testing anything.

teaches.description: What this question tests. The result screen groups wrong answers by these, so a learner is told which topic to revisit rather than only a score.
